entries.meaning: Required signature, historical authority, qualification, or finality proof is absent or invalid.
The same immutable identity is already bound to different canonical bytes or state.
Canonical bytes, digest, size, request, envelope, artifact, or receipt binding does not match.
The request is structurally invalid and no narrower released error applies.
Audience, purpose, disclosure, encryption, or retrieval policy denies the operation.
A released byte, item, proof-work, queue, storage, or query bound was exceeded.
The Writer Fence is expired, superseded, out of scope, or below the authority high-water.
Required retained bytes, authority history, sink resolution, or evidence is currently unavailable.
A required profile or version has no released verifier in this implementation.
